implementation: ACodeZombieActor::ApplyStandardDirectPursuitProfile opts ordinary pressure zombies into StandardDirectPursuitZombie, ZombiePursuitReadableRuntime, FairSurvivalPressure, NoLearningZonePressure, and AttackWindupReadable tags.
playability_result: Regular city threats become auditable as fair direct-pursuit enemies instead of anonymous damage sources.

implementation: ACodeZombieActor::Tick derives attack telegraph timing and melee damage from StandardPursuitAttackCooldown, AttackTelegraphRangeMultiplier, and AttackTelegraphLeadSeconds.
playability_result: The player sees red windup glow and receives captions before ordinary melee damage applies.

implementation: Standard pursuit zombies add StandardPursuitProtectedCodingSpaceHold and StandardPursuitNoLearningZonePressure while the player is inside protected coding space.
playability_result: Zombie pressure resumes only after the player leaves learning areas, preserving the selected-language terminal loop.

implementation: ACodeRescueAIController tags StandardPursuitDirectChase, StandardPursuitMoveDirectlyTowardPlayer, and StandardPursuitAttackHold when profiled zombies chase or hold attack range.
playability_result: Reviewers can confirm ordinary pressure is direct, readable, and not a hidden patrol-only behavior.

implementation: Regular city waves, physics ambush zombies, encounter director zombies, language breach patrols, boss horde zombies, and boomer adds call ApplyStandardDirectPursuitProfile and tag their helper markers.
playability_result: Every common non-boss pressure path presents the same fair pursuit contract while special boss and elite staging remain distinct.
validation: verify_standard_direct_pursuit_zombie_slice_pass.py plus manual standard pursuit combat review

implementation: UCodeRescueHUDWidget surfaces standard pursuit state in THREAT COMPASS, PURSUIT PRESSURE alerts, and tactical readout text; ACodeZombieActor pushes pursuit, closing, windup, attack, cover, and protected-hold captions.
playability_result: The player can identify direction, distance, role, pursuit state, and imminent attack without relying on color alone.
